grammarFocus: was / were；常用过去式入门；be going to；because；基础句型综合复习。
title: A Busy Week for Li Ming
instructions: 阅读短文，然后回答问题。请根据短文内容选择正确答案或填写单词。所有题目均为单选题或填空题。短文和题目均为模拟教学材料，不是官方考试。
passage: Li Ming is a student. He was busy last week. On Monday, he was at school. He was in the library. On Tuesday, he was at the park. He was with his friend, Wang Fang. They were happy. On Wednesday, he was at home. He was sick. He was in bed. On Thursday, he was at the doctor. He was better. On Friday, he was at the shop. He was with his mother. They were at the shop because they needed food. On Saturday, he was at the cinema. He was with Wang Fang. The film was good. On Sunday, he was at home. He was tired. He is going to rest tomorrow because he is going to be busy next week.

questions.prompt: Where was Li Ming on Monday?
questions.explanation: 短文第一句说：On Monday, he was at school. 所以选 at school。
questions.evidence: On Monday, he was at school.

questions.prompt: Who was with Li Ming on Tuesday?
questions.explanation: 短文说：On Tuesday, he was at the park. He was with his friend, Wang Fang. 所以选 Wang Fang。
questions.evidence: He was with his friend, Wang Fang.

questions.prompt: How was Li Ming on Wednesday?
questions.explanation: 短文说：On Wednesday, he was at home. He was sick. 所以选 sick。

questions.prompt: Where was Li Ming on Thursday?
questions.explanation: 短文说：On Thursday, he was at the doctor. 所以选 at the doctor。
questions.evidence: On Thursday, he was at the doctor.

questions.prompt: Why were Li Ming and his mother at the shop?
questions.explanation: 短文说：They were at the shop because they needed food. 所以选 because they needed food。
questions.evidence: They were at the shop because they needed food.

questions.prompt: How was the film on Saturday?
questions.explanation: 短文说：The film was good. 所以选 good。

questions.prompt: On Sunday, Li Ming was at home because he was ______. (用短文中的一个词填空)
questions.explanation: 短文说：On Sunday, he was at home. He was tired. 所以填 tired。

questions.prompt: Li Ming is going to ______ tomorrow because he is going to be busy next week. (用短文中的一个词填空)
questions.explanation: 短文最后说：He is going to rest tomorrow because he is going to be busy next week. 所以填 rest。
questions.evidence: He is going to rest tomorrow because he is going to be busy next week.

grammar.title: Past Simple: was/were; be going to; because
grammar.explanation: 我们用 was 和 were 来谈论过去。I/he/she/it 用 was，you/we/they 用 were。例如：He was at school. They were happy. 我们用 be going to 来谈论计划。例如：He is going to rest. 我们用 because 来说明原因。例如：They were at the shop because they needed food.
grammar.example: He was at school. They were happy. He is going to rest tomorrow because he is going to be busy next week.

questions.explanation: 主语是 She，过去时用 was，所以选 She was at home.

options: They are at the park yesterday.
